children: Gulf Resources, through its subsidiary Shouguang City Haoyuan Chemical Company, entered into an asset purchase agreement to acquire bromine and crude salt production assets in Shouguang City, China, including facilities, equipment and about 1.29 square kilometers of salt fields. The RMB 103.5 million purchase price includes RMB 95.2 million in cash and 355,000 restricted Gulf Resources shares valued at RMB 8.3 million. Closing is expected by December 31, 2026, subject to a satisfactory asset assessment and other conditions.
